# Branding Guidelines Skill 

Use this skill whenever creating, reviewing, or editing presentations, slide decks, infographics, posters, diagrams, dashboards, social media visuals, documents, or any other visual communication materials for Houston ISD. 

The authoritative source for all branding decisions is:

- references/HISD-Brand-Guidelines-SPR2025-(HC).pdf 

Always consult this document before generating or modifying visual or presentation content.
 
## Requirements
 
- Follow the approved HISD color palette exactly as defined in the guidelines.
- Use the specified typography and font hierarchy.
- Apply logo usage, spacing, sizing, and placement rules from the guidelines.
- Maintain the approved visual style for imagery, icons, shapes, and graphics.
- Preserve accessibility and readability standards described in the document.
- Keep layouts consistent with the branding guidance for presentations and visual materials.
- Do not invent new brand colors, fonts, logo treatments, or visual styles.
- If a requested design conflicts with the branding guidelines, explain the conflict and follow the guidelines.

## Scope

This skill is intended for:

- PowerPoint and Google Slides presentations
- Executive and board presentations
- Infographics and one-pagers
- Posters and flyers
- Dashboards and visual reports
- Social media graphics
- Internal and external communication visuals

When providing design recommendations, reference the HISD branding guidelines as the primary authority and prioritize brand consistency across all visual assets.
